hypotheses.justification: Let C = (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ, which is measurable by measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice. Retain the existing proof as a local claim for every measurable subset of C. Measure.restrict_congr_meas then shows that (withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a).restrict C = (κ a).restrict C. Evaluate this equality on the arbitrary set s and apply Measure.restrict_eq_self on both sides using hs. This requires no measurability of s and also covers empty sets and zero measures.
